verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PDF/corpus upload (up to 500k words/200MB per source), grounded Q&A with in-line citations tied to source location, source selection for scoped answers, and summary/insight generation — directly matching the researcher's upload-and-query workflow. Community feedback corroborates real-world use for structured research, with only minor gaps noted (e.g., no auto-search/discovery of new docs, email import friction). Missing for 10: independent benchmark of research accuracy across large corpora and confirmation of multi-document cross-referencing depth.
